item.title: Constant Traffic build up all day, 4th August
item.description:
Constant traffic all day building up, the fumes are making my daughter’s asthma worse and I suffer from migraines. As a resident on this road I would have expected a letter to be sent explaining what was happening and how long for. It’s causing a lot of disruptions and my daughter has had to cancel her dentist appointment because of it. If there was an emergency for either myself or my husband it would be a lot of worry to think how an ambulance would even get to us, as we are both in our 80s it has caused us a lot of unnecessary stress.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 32, Linchmere Road, Hither Green, Grove Park, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
